summary: Made roadmap-integration.sh /todo's single parser and structure-signal source: parse-only scan filtered to meta/expanded-eligible tasks, --annotate against a pre-archival filtered snapshot for completed tasks, and /todo-owned abandoned-task annotation gated on parseable. Both commands/todo.md and skill-todo/SKILL.md updated; a three-way output-gate branch replaces the silent-omission defect in both specs. Acceptance test (zero-structure fixture -> parseable=false, unparseable_roadmap) and non-regression test (real ROADMAP.md -> parseable=true, checkboxes=12) both passed live.
decisions_made: Adopted option (b): reuse the shared script as sole parser/writer for the completed-task path, keep meta/expanded exclusion and abandoned-task annotation as /todo-owned logic
Step 5.5 snapshot must be built from Step 3.5's pre-archival roadmap_eligible_tasks[] capture, since Step 5.5 runs after Step 5 archival
Snapshot lives in a scratch mktemp -d dir so the script's sibling-archive lookup resolves to nothing, deliberately excluding previously-archived tasks from this run's annotation
dead_ends: Initial Step 3.5 Match Types note copied the research report's inaccurate 'table-based, zero checkboxes' premise -- caught and corrected during Phase 6's own consistency sweep; live ROADMAP.md is actually checkboxes=12, table_rows=0
